QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Please Help Us Clean Francis's Room
QuestInfo.0: #bBlack Wings' secretary #p2154002##k at the #b#m310050000##k in the Mine is swamped with work. Talk to #p2154002#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154002#, the Black Wing secretary, takes care of every trivial thing to prepare those who return from business trips. #p2154002# says Francis's room is a mess, and she would like you to eliminate Francis's Dolls, which have been acting up. #bEnter Francis's room located to the left#k and take care of the Dolls.\n\n#o9300416##r #a239541##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated all of Francis's Dolls. You hope Francis won't be upset... #p2154002# didn't seem worried.

0.0: Hello, I've never seen you before. You must be new. Please allow me to introduce myself. I am #p2154002#, the Black Wings secretary. My job is mostly to take care of the administrative stuff for my bosses.
0.1: I say administrative, but really my work is pretty trivial... Preparing tea, organizing clothes, and even taking care of pets, that kind of thing. Luckily the pay is good. Otherwise, I would have quit a long time ago.
0.2: Hey, you look like you're pretty strong. Think you'll be promoted soon? Maybe you can help me out, then... You see, there's a teensy little problem in #bFrancis's room#k...
0.3: Francis is out of business and the puppets in his room are going nuts. Can you quiet them down?

yes.0: The #broom to the left#k is Francis's room. Please go inside and make the #rnoisy puppets#k be quiet. Taking care of about #r50#k of them should do the trick. Thank you.

no.0: Oh, are you busy with something? Surely you're not as busy as me though right? You're not busy secretly meeting with the people in town right?

1.0: You've made the #o9300416#s be quiet. Now I'll be able to get some rest! Thank you so much.

yes.0: And don't worry. I won't tell Francis you were in his room...

mob.0: Haven't you gone to #bFrancis's Room#k yet? You just need to enter the #bdoor to the left#k. Please go inside and make #r50 #o9300416# enemies#k be quiet.
